title: Manufacturing in Motion: Navigating Supply Chain, ERP, and Global Compliance Change
summary: Vertex is the leading and most-trusted provider of comprehensive, integrated tax technology solutions, having helped 10,000+ businesses since 1978.
body_markdown:
Manufacturers are navigating a rapidly changing operating environment shaped by shifting trade policies, supply chain disruption, cost pressures, ERP modernization, and expanding global compliance requirements. As operations evolve, tax complexity can emerge across procurement, production, intercompany activity, and distribution, particularly for organizations operating across multiple plants, jurisdictions, and systems.


In this on-demand webinar, Vertex manufacturing experts discuss the trends affecting manufacturers and share practical insights for managing supply chain change, improving procurement tax accuracy, maintaining consistency through ERP transformation, and preparing for evolving digital compliance requirements.


Watch the webinar to explore how manufacturers can build more consistent and adaptable tax processes amid ongoing business and technology change.


## Learning Objective


- How to respond to supply chain and sourcing changes without creating inconsistent tax outcomes.
- How manufacturers can maintain tax consistency during ERP modernization and cloud migration.
- How to prepare systems and data for expanding digital tax and reporting requirements.
- Tax considerations associated with procurement, production, intercompany activity, and distribution.
- The importance of improving procurement tax accuracy as manufacturing operations change.
